p: A corporate IT team of three people, a man in a navy business suit, a woman in a navy business suit, and a man in a light blue shirt with a lanyard, standing together around a blank laptop and a small server rack, with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face floating beside them.
A tired male IT support staff member in a navy business suit searching through piles of blank folders and many open blank documents at a desk with a blank monitor, looking exhausted.

A female IT engineer in a navy business suit at a desk building a simple diagram of connected blank boxes on a blank screen together with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face that holds a blank sheet.
A busy male IT administrator in a navy business suit overwhelmed by copying between several blank monitors, with stacks of blank papers, ID cards and laptops around him.

A female employee in a navy business suit at a laptop, asking a question while a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face hands her one tidy blank guide sheet, with neat blank folders behind it.

Blank envelopes flowing from the left and being sorted into three neat colored trays by a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face, while a male IT staff member in a navy business suit watches and points at one tray.

A male employee in a navy business suit holding a blank ID card up to a laptop showing a large padlock opening, with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face next to a checkmark shield.

A female IT engineer in a navy business suit standing beside a server rack with one amber warning light, looking at a blank tablet, while a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face holds up two matching blank record cards.

A male IT engineer in a navy business suit at a desk watching a blank monitor showing a chain of connected blank boxes with one amber broken link, with a bell notification icon and a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face beside him.

Two colleagues, a woman and a man in navy business suits, reviewing one large blank checklist board with checkmarks, connected by simple arrows to a small server rack, in place of a pile of blank envelopes on the floor.

A female IT engineer in a navy business suit speaking to a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face, which arranges connected blank boxes into a simple flowchart on a large blank screen.

A new employee in a navy business suit receiving a blank ID badge from a female HR staff member in a navy business suit, with simple icons of a key and a shield and three blank laptops connected by lines, and a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face.

A male IT staff member in a navy business suit handing a closed laptop to a female employee in a navy business suit across a counter, with a shelf of closed laptops behind and a blank clipboard on the counter.

A female IT administrator in a navy business suit reviewing a row of blank seat-shaped cards, some filled in blue and some empty outlines, collecting the empty ones into a tray, while a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face points at a blank list, without characters.
